h1: ♄ Saturn in Astrology: Structure • Time • Mastery
subtitle: Domicile: Capricorn , Aquarius • Exaltation: Libra
summary: In astrology, Saturn signifies structure, discipline, time, limits, and accountability. Its sign, house, and aspects pinpoint where sustained effort, boundaries, and mastery are demanded, often through delays or tests that yield durable results. The Saturn return around every 29.5 years and major transits mark phases of maturation, course correction, and tangible rewards for consistent work. Traditionally ruling Capricorn and Aquarius and exalted in Libra, Saturn is in detriment in Cancer and Leo and in fall in Aries, coloring how its lessons are experienced.

sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Saturn is your spine: reality checks, patience, and craft. Fed well, it’s mastery and quiet pride. Starved, it becomes fear, delay, and rules without love.

✅ What it wants

  • Clear standards and real deadlines
  • Reps, mentorship, and scope control
  • Promises you actually keep

⚠️ When it struggles

  • All-or-nothing perfectionism
  • Cold rules; shame as fuel
  • Busywork to avoid the big thing

🧭 Feed it well

  • Define “done”; ship small and often
  • Weekly review: cut half, commit to few
  • Choose hard things on purpose

sections.heading: Returns & Cycles (the 7/14/21/29 clock)
sections.html:
Saturn return

  • ~29–30 and ~58–60: reset duty and craft
  • House + aspects set the curriculum
  • Choose constraints that serve your goals

Squares & oppositions

  • ~7, ~14, ~21 years: course-corrections
  • Ship, prune, and recommit
  • Journal decisions; let data age

Retrograde rhythm

  • ~4.5 months each year
  • Review boundaries, budgets, and scope
  • Watch aspects (e.g., Saturn square Uranus)

sections.heading: Quick Practice (build what lasts)

faqs.q: What happens at the Saturn return?
faqs.a: You restructure commitments. Some roles end, others deepen. Use the house to pick what to keep and what to close.
